hero.title: Cardity Core
hero.subtitle: Turn one sentence into the protocol contract an agent can build from.
hero.description: Cardity Core compiles Cardity protocol source into ABI, protocol JSON, and Agent OS manifests with API, database, read-model, action, workflow, permission, projection, schema, and conformance contracts.

pipeline.title: From one protocol to a buildable system
pipeline.subtitle: Cardity is the deterministic contract layer between natural-language agents and production code generation. Agent action contract v1 plus projection contract v1.1 are now the stable downstream baseline.

steps.title: Describe intent
steps.description: An agent or developer starts with a business rule, workflow, or protocol idea.

steps.title: Compile protocol
steps.description: Cardity Core validates the source and emits a stable machine-readable protocol contract.

steps.title: Generate system plan
steps.description: The Agent OS manifest exposes API routes, database tables, read models, generic action contracts, workflows, permissions, projections, modules, and external services.

steps.title: Build with agents
steps.description: Downstream agents can generate services, UI, tests, and runtime integrations from the same source of truth.

artifacts.title: Artifacts agents can trust
artifacts.subtitle: The public API is compiler-only: it accepts source text and returns structured artifacts without signing, deploying, or reading a user's workspace.

items.title: ABI
items.description: Typed method definitions, parameters, return values, and callable protocol shape.

items.title: Protocol JSON
items.description: A normalized representation of protocol state, methods, events, and metadata.

items.title: Agent OS manifest
items.description: System API, database tables, UI actions, workflows, permissions, modules, external entries, and tool contracts.

items.title: Agent action contract v1
items.description: Generic action semantics, planner hints, input/output schemas, confirmation, dry-run, readback, idempotency, risk, audit, and replay metadata.

items.title: Projection contract v1.1
items.description: Read models, upsert snapshots, deltas, composite keys, confirmed readback, runtime_fields, and replay-safe idempotency metadata.

items.title: Machine-readable schemas
items.description: Agent manifest, action contract, and projection contract schemas with local conformance checks for downstream runtimes.

integrations.title: Designed for every agent surface
integrations.subtitle: Use Cardity Core remotely today, or keep it local when a desktop agent needs filesystem-level control.

items.title: Public API
items.description: Call https://api.cardity.org from any agent, workflow, or backend service. The hosted compiler emits the same contract baseline as the local CLI.

items.title: MCP endpoint
items.description: Discover cardity_compile and cardity_manifest through the hosted JSON-RPC MCP endpoint, then feed the manifest into Agent OS generation.

items.title: CLI and local MCP
items.description: Run the same compiler locally for private workspaces and deeper Agent OS integrations with the same schema and conformance checks.

registry.title: Discover templates, schemas, badges, and packages from one catalog.
registry.subtitle: Cardity Registry gives agents and runtimes a stable discovery layer for official protocol templates, contract schemas, runtime adapters, compatibility badges, and .carditypkg examples.

items.title: Templates
items.description: Official protocol starters for member points, refunds, support tickets, and agent tool permissions.

items.title: Schemas
items.description: Stable URLs for manifest, action, projection, conformance, package, and registry schemas.

items.title: Runtime badges
items.description: Compatibility status that downstream runtimes can publish without giving Cardity execution authority.

items.title: .carditypkg
items.description: Portable package examples with hashes so runtimes can verify protocol artifacts before installing.

cta.title: Give agents a protocol before they write code
cta.subtitle: A precise protocol contract lets agents generate systems with clearer permissions, routes, actions, read models, projections, workflows, and replay rules.
